messages:
Matt: Heads up — I'm seeing p95 tail latency regressions on /v1/embeddings when clients send mixed-dim batches with payloads > ~250KB. Can we sync on routing/quota SLO and console signals? :eyes:
Anya: Oof. Do you have a repro or sample request + metric window? Is this specific to mixed dims or any large request?
Matt: Mostly mixed dims. Example (redacted):
```
{
  "input": [ {"id":"a", "vec_dims":1536, ...}, {"id":"b", "vec_dims":768, ...}, ... ]
}
```
PromQL I used:
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(embeddings_token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le,tenant))
```
Spike window: 10:12-10:28 UTC.
Anya: That aligns with telemetry where the splitter couldn't coalesce and we fell back to the safe slow-path. That path batch-coalesces poorly so per-token latency + CPU jumps.
Dinesh: Idea: implement an adaptive sub-batch splitter on ingress that groups same-dim items into sub-batches, preserving original ordering where possible, then route sub-batches to fast kernels. Metric: emit `embed.split.subbatches` to measure added sub-batch count.
Ryan: Console ask: add a 'Batch Health' widget on per-route pages showing: % mixed-dim, avg batch_bytes, % routed to fallback in last 1h. PMs want to see regressions fast.
console-bot: Runbook pinned: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-batch-fallback — remediation + quick queries.
Anya: Rollout safety proposal:
- Feature flag: adaptive-subbatch-splitter OFF by default
- Opt-in toggle in Console per-tenant
- Alert if fallback_rate > 5% for 5m or p95 latency >10% vs baseline
- Soft 413 fast-fail option for >500KB payloads to protect runtime
Matt: Agree on opt-in. Add preflight header negotiation to help routing: X-Embed-Dims: "1536,768,768" so we can decide before body parsing.
Dinesh: Header helps early routing but can be spoofed or inconsistent. Validate against body; if mismatch, fallback to body-inspect. Header mainly reduces memory pressure at ingress.
Ryan: Dashboard panels to add in Console v2:
- % requests with mixed dims (1h/24h)
- sub-batch count distribution
- fallback -> fastpath ratio + cost delta per-tenant
- p50/p95 token latency split by route and by fastpath vs fallback
Anya: Telemetry keys to add:
- embed.request.size_bytes
- embed.batch.mixed_count
- embed.split.subbatches
- embed.route.fallbacks
- embed.preflight.reject_413
Matt: Implementation note: splitter should prefer dim-homogeneity over strict byte cap to preserve kernel efficiency; aim for ~200KB target per sub-batch but allow variance if dims mismatch would otherwise force tiny homogeneous sub-batches.
deploy-bot: Canary for adaptive-subbatch-splitter scheduled: 2026-03-21T02:00:00Z -> 20% traffic, 3h evaluation window.
Ryan: Can we auto-scale route capacity temporarily during the canary? That should reduce transient rejects and give clearer signal.
Dinesh: We'll add a temporary policy: increase dedicated slots for the route during canary if fallback_rate > 3%.
Anya: I'll draft the PR for console panels + feature flag UX. Matt/Dinesh can pair on the router/splitter change.
Matt: I'll add telemetry queries to the runbook and iterate alert thresholds after first canary. Will keep thread for follow-ups. If canary shows regressions I'll post a short post-mortem here.
Ryan: :thumbsup:
